name: Unified private assistant tasks

dataIsolation.guard: Private LINE messages resolve to exactly one HOZO AM 2.0 line-user principal before any AM task read or write. Created tasks are tenant-scoped through the existing Notion request guard and carry LINE direct source evidence.

definitionOfDone: HOZO direct Rich Menu actions for 我的今日, 我的行事曆, 新增待辦 and 昨日未完成 are handled by the personal assistant task controller
Natural-language and numbered multi-task create requests are previewed and require 確認新增 before AM task writes
Private tasks write to AM tasks with owner, due date, manual source and source evidence
Rental Calendar personal item create/update/query and Portal binding are not required for private task use
AM task Calendar projection is disabled unless a tenant explicitly sets config.calendarProjection.enabled=true
HOZO LLM cheap profile uses MiniMax-M3 through the tenant LLM interface
Non-text direct messages no longer trigger repeated identity fallback replies
